## Load dataset

```{webr-r}
library(COUNT)
data(nuts)
head(nuts)
```


## Visualise data

```{webr-r}
plot()
```


## Fit model

Analyse the influence of environmental factors on the number of cones consumed by squirrels

```{webr-r}
model <- glm()
summary(model)
```


## Visualise model

```{webr-r}
library(visreg)
visreg(model)
```


## Check model

```{webr-r}
library(easystats)
check_model(model)
```
